name: Can I install new flooring over an uneven subfloor?

mainEntity.name: Can I install new flooring over an uneven subfloor?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is generally not recommended to install new flooring over an uneven subfloor. Doing so can lead to a host of problems, including premature wear and tear on the new flooring, creaking or squeaking sounds, gaps forming between floorboards, and even breakage of materials like tile. An uneven subfloor can also void warranties on new flooring products. Proper preparation, including leveling and repairing the subfloor, is a critical step to ensure the longevity, stability, and aesthetic quality of your new floor installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, installing new flooring over an uneven subfloor is not recommended as it can cause premature wear, creaking, gaps, and void warranties. Leveling the subfloor first is crucial.
